name: dsh-copilot-acp
description: GitHub Copilot (the official Copilot CLI) as an ACP subagent for DeepSeek Harness: install it, sign in once, and the agent can delegate work to Copilot.
comment: The two @deepseek-ai backends are pinned exactly: a mismatched harness line fails their peer ranges (npm 'latest' for dsh-subagent-acp is 0.0.1-rc.1, incompatible with a 0.1.2-rc.1 harness). Bump both when the harness moves.
